result.description: MYT Framing Solutions  MYT Framing Pty Ltd is seeking a full-time Production Operator to assist with the manufacturing and assembly of light gauge steel framing components for residential and commercial construction projects. The role involves operating production machinery, cutting, shaping, assembling and finishing steel framing components, monitoring equipment, conducting quality checks, maintaining safe work practices, and preparing completed products for dispatch.  The successful candidate will support the production of wall frames, roof trusses, floor joists and other structural steel components, ensuring all products are manufactured accurately, efficiently and in accordance with company standards and project specifications.   Benefits   Competitive salary package with Superannuation  Full time job opportunity and long term career prospects  Supportive, team based environment  Ongoing training and skill development opportunities  On site Parking  Task & Responsibilities  Operate production equipment in a safe and efficient manner.  Handle raw materials, including steel components.  Assist with the production, assembly and preparation of frames for construction projects.  Maintain a clean and safe work environment.  Follow work instructions and company safety policies.    Task & responsibilities   Operating specialised production machinery and equipment used for cutting, shaping, joining, assembling and finishing steel framing components.  Reading and following production sheets, technical specifications, drawings and work instructions to ensure accurate manufacturing of housing components.  Calibrating machinery, monitoring gauges and making necessary adjustments to maintain smooth and efficient production.  Conducting regular checks on machinery and equipment to ensure safe and effective operation.  Performing basic troubleshooting, minor repairs and adjustments to machinery where required.  Carrying out quality checks on finished components to ensure they meet company standards, project requirements and relevant construction specifications.  Identifying and reporting defects, production issues or equipment faults to supervisors in a timely manner.  Assisting with the packaging, labelling and preparation of completed framing components for dispatch to construction sites.  Checking and maintaining material inventory levels, including assisting with monthly stock counts and warehouse organisation.  Following workplace health and safety procedures, equipment manuals and company policies at all times.  Maintaining a clean, organised and safe production area to support efficient workflow and reduce downtime.  Working collaboratively with production, warehouse, logistics and site teams to ensure orders are completed accurately and delivered on schedule.    Qualification & experience  The successful candidate must have at least  2 year of relevant work experience  in a production, manufacturing, fabrication, construction, steel framing or similar industrial environment.   The candidate should be able to read and follow production sheets, technical drawings, equipment manuals and workplace safety instructions. They should have practical knowledge of machine operation, material handling, basic troubleshooting, quality checking and safe workplace practices.  Experience in light gauge steel framing, structural steel fabrication, warehouse operations, inventory control or dispatch preparation would be advantageous.   The candidate must demonstrate strong attention to detail, good teamwork skills, the ability to follow instructions, and a commitment to maintaining quality, safety and productivity standards.  About Company    MYT Framing Pty Ltd is a South Australian company specialising in light gauge steel framing and structural steel solutions for residential and commercial building projects. The company provides a complete service including drafting, engineering, fabrication, delivery and installation of steel framing components.  MYT Framing works with commercial builders, boutique home builders and property developers, offering reliable advice, precision fabrication and professional installation services. The company focuses on delivering high-quality, accurate and durable steel framing products while maintaining strong standards of safety, efficiency and workmanship.
